label: copy-phase input r early in the copy of length-9 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only (99.9% of mass) when the token being fed back in is the letter r. The firing is weak and close to threshold (max 0.008). It is strongly tied to position: L=9 holds 90% of mass and L=8 about 10%, and it peaks at t=12 (recall_idx 3, meaning the r was original token 2). Recall_idx 4 adds about 19% and the last two copy steps of L=9 add about 7%. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, and never when r is input at t<10 or in sequences shorter than 7. The strongest examples are all L=9 with r at original position 2, fed back at t=12. Precision is limited: even under the exact condition (r input at t=12, L=9) it fires only about 39% of the time, and no simple token-history variable separates the firing cases from the silent ones.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=r (+3.96), recall_idx=3 & in_tok=r (+2.96), prev_tok=u (+2.74), in_tok=r (+2.21), phase=2 & out_tok=i (+2.16), prev_tok=2 (+1.71). Lower it: orig8=- (-2.60), orig7=- (-1.91), next_out=q (-1.82), orig0=e (-1.63).
